summary: A mayor proposes a liability-insurance rule for a regulated product, the council passes it, and a group announces a lawsuit the same night.
realLife: Liccardo's 2021 State of the City said the city would pursue gun liability insurance and fees. On January 25, 2022 the San Jose council approved an ordinance requiring owners to carry coverage and pay an annual fee of about $25. A gun-rights group said it would sue.
sources: Read the State of the City transcript and CBS News's report on the vote. CBS gives no exact tally.
inGame: The local ordinance engine's bill row and a lawsuit-announced event on the news record. needs: a catalog policy for firearm liability insurance.

turns.what: The council sends the proposal to study and does not vote.
